{{Top|leg}}
A '''Complex''' was a type of fence used in [[swoopchasing]]. They were specialized and high involved, requiring the [[swoopchaser]] to negotiate them with skill. Specific types of Complexes included the [[Arena Complex]], the [[Tube Complex]], the [[Labyrinth Complex]], and the [[Water Complex]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
